description:
Built to order - all sizes are currently available to purchase, with quick turnaround for pickup or delivery.

The Bassi Bloomfield is back with a beautiful bright green color and some very cool updates.
This iteration of the frame feature canti post and is now 650B specific.

Ever since its inception in 2009, Bassi has been known for classy single speed and track cycles. From the Roma-Tokyo Keirin inspired chromoly frameset to the aluminium and carbon 03 pursuit machine, one-geared rides are practical, lightweight, and reliable city commuters. The Bloomfield is no different, although it’s adapted to modern sensibilities with chunkier tire clearance, more eyelets for bottle cages, racks and fenders.

Built here with an upright swept-back handlebar, in-house hand-laced wheels, sealed bearing hubs and bottom bracket, it should strike a perfect balance between speediness and comfort. All sizes now are 650B specific for more comfort (47mm tires), and some gravel/off-road capability.

Build specs

Bassi Classic track crankset, 46 teeth

18-tooth freewheel or cog

Handbuilt wheels with High Flange Track Hubs in silver

Panaracer Pasela tires

Bassi Rachel saddle

Tange CDS headset

Bassi Quill Stem

Bassi x Nitto Heat-Treated Bobby Bar

Tektro V-brake calipers and levers

Bassi frame strap

Frame features and specs

Straight blade fork with 1” threaded steerer and canti post

Hidden front and rear fender eyelets

Front mini-rack eyelets (for models like Soma Champs Elysées, Velo Orange Randonneur, and Surly 8- or 24-pack)

2 sets of bottle cage eyelets

Clearance for 650Bx42 with fenders, or 650Bx47 without

Horizontal track ends, 120mm spacing

Eyelets on seat tube and top tube for shoulder strap

* all measurements are in millimeters except for angle measurements which are in degrees and minimum PBH which are in cm.

Please note that the lowest set of eyelets on the fork and on the seatstays are for fenders only. They are not meant to bear the load of a rack.
